sentence: This project builds models of human ectodermal development from stem cells to study how cell signaling guides cell fate and shape.
This project studies how kidney damage happens in a premature aging disease and looks for ways to prevent it.
This project looks for inherited genetic factors that affect the start and progress of cancers driven by one signaling pathway.
This project studies how chemicals and fatty acids from the environment change the lipid profile and function of the heart.
This project tries to find out how problems in fat tissue near the heart lead to heart disease in people with type 1 diabetes.
This project builds computer methods and lab tests to study how gene regulation works in single cells.
This project searches for disease-causing changes in the non-coding part of the genome and tests which ones affect gene regulation.
This project studies how far a drug resistance marker in the malaria parasite has spread in Africa and how strong the resistance is.
This project studies a specific type of brain cell that helps control social behavior.
This project studies how proteins work in immune pathways that help the body fight viruses and builds a method to map similar pathways.
This project builds computer methods that combine simulations and machine learning to speed up the search for drug molecules.
This project uses sequencing to identify and describe the viruses found in human samples along the oral-gut-brain axis.
This project uses CRISPR gene editing in zebrafish to study how genes affect brain development and epilepsy and to screen drugs.
This project develops compounds that block an ion channel in sperm to work as male contraceptives.
This project looks at how genomic information can be used to provide personalized health care.
This project studies how parts of the brain called the cortex and thalamus influence circuits in the dorsal striatum that control holding back a response.
This project studies how the cytoskeleton of a parasite helps it divide, move and stick to host cells during infection.
This project renovates a data center and adds a liquid cooling system and uninterruptible power supplies for high-performance computing.
This project provides statistical and epidemiology methods that support research on HIV and AIDS.
This project searches the whole genome for genetic risk factors for breast cancer in women of African ancestry and how they affect racial differences.
